interface.name: ukui_shell_v1

description.summary: create ukui shell surfaces and helpers

interface.description: This interface is used by UKUI Wayland shells to communicate with the compositor and can only be bound one time.

request.name: create_surface

description.summary: create a shell surface from a surface

request.description:
Create a shell surface for an existing surface.
Only one shell surface can be associated with a given surface. Should create ukui_surface_v1 before create xdg_surface and surface map.

request.name: get_current_output

description.summary: get output under cursor

request.description:
Request get the output under cursor per seat.
Send current_output and done event after this request.

request.name: create_decoration

description.summary: create a shell decoration from a surface

request.description:
Create a shell decoration for an existing surface.
Only one shell decoration can be associated with a given surface. This request needs be called before surface map.

event.name: current_output

description.summary: send the output name under cursor

event.description: Emitted after bind ukui_shell or receive get_current_output request.

arg.name: seat_name
arg.summary: seat name of cursor under output

event.name: done

description.summary: sent all output and seat info completely

event.description: This event is sent after all information have been sent on binding to the ukui shell object.

interface.name: ukui_surface_v1

description.summary: metadata interface

interface.description:
An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for implementations that provide the shell user interface.
It provides requests to set surface roles, state or set the position in global coordinates.
On the server side the object is automatically destroyed when the related wl_surface is destroyed. On client side, ukui_surface_v1.destroy() must be called before destroying the wl_surface object.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: remove ukui_surface_v1 interface

request.description: The ukui_surface_v1 interface is removed from the wl_surface object that was turned into a shell surface with the ukui_shell_v1.get_surface request.

request.name: set_position

description.summary: change the shell surface position

request.description: Move the surface to new coordinates. Coordinates are global.

request.name: set_skip_taskbar

description.summary: make the surface skip the taskbar

request.description:
Setting this will say the surface prefers to not be listed in the taskbar.
This request needs be called before surface map.

arg.name: skip
arg.summary: Boolean value that sets whether to skip the taskbar

request.name: set_skip_switcher

description.summary: make the surface not appear in a switcher

request.description:
Setting this will say the surface prefers to not be listed in the switcher.
This request needs be called before surface map.

arg.name: skip
arg.summary: Boolean value that sets whether to skip the switcher

request.name: set_role

description.summary: assign a role to this surface

request.description:
Assign a role to a shell surface.
The compositor handles surfaces depending on their role.
This request needs be called before surface map.

request.name: set_state

description.summary: set surface state

request.description:
Set surface state. Can set multiple states at once. Values for state argument are described by ukui_surface.state and can be used together in a bitfield. The flags bitfield describes which flags are supposed to be set, the state bitfield the value for the set flags.
The state argument is not a boolean value, but a bitfield, so it is possible to set multiple states at once. Only the states that are set in the flags bitfield will be changed. The keep_above and keep_below can only used for the normal window.
For example:
If flags was 0x12(movable|maximizable) and state was 0x02(maximizable), the window would be maximizable, but not movable.

request.name: set_panel_auto_hide

description.summary: auto hide the panel

request.description: Setting this bit will indicate that the panel area not to be calculate in output usable area.

arg.name: hide
arg.summary: Boolean value that sets whether to hide the panel

request.name: open_under_cursor

description.summary: open under cursor

request.description:
Request the initial position of this surface to be under the current cursor position.
This request needs be called before surface map.

request.name: grab_keyboard

description.summary: make the surface take keyboard grab

request.description: This request makes the created surface take an explicit keyboard grab. This keyboard grab will be dismissed when the client destroys the surface. Grab all keyboard when seat is set to null.

arg.name: seat
arg.summary: the seat for which the keyboard should be grabbed

request.name: set_icon

description.summary: set server decoration icon

request.description: Setting server decoration icon by icon name. Set icon name to null will use app_id to find icon. This request needs be called before surface map.

event.name: position

description.summary: informs of a new position for the surface

event.description: This event informs the client that the position of the surface is about to change.

arg.name: x
arg.summary: the horizontal position of the surface

arg.name: y
arg.summary: the vertical position of the surface

request.name: activate

description.summary: set the surface active state

request.description: This request makes the created surface to be activated. There is no guarantee the surface will be actually activated, and behaviour may be compositor-dependentption.

request.name: set_startup_geometry

description.summary: set the startup geometry for the surface

request.description: Sets the startup geometry of the taskbar/desktop entry for this surface. Coordinates are global. One established way of doing this is through the UKUI_SURFACE_STARTUP_GEOMETRY environment variable of a newly launched child process. The child process should unset the environment variable again right after reading it out in order to avoid propagating it to other child processes. This request needs be called before surface map.

request.name: show_tile_flyout

description.summary: show tile flyout to control window tile preview

request.description: This request is for showing tile flyout on the client side decoration. The parameters represent a mouse region, tile flyout will autohide when mouse leave the region. Coordinates are relative to the surface. Use default seat when seat is set to null. This request needs be called after surface map.

arg.name: seat
arg.summary: the seat which mouse belongs to

event.name: surface_state

description.summary: surface state has been changed

event.description:
This event will be sent as soon as the surface state changes.
Values for state argument are described by ukui_surface_v1.surface_state. It contains the whole new state of the window.

request.name: set_restore_geometry

description.summary: set the restore geometry for the surface

request.description: Set the restore geometry for this surface. The restore geometry is used for window doing restore from maximized/fullscreen state. Coordinates are global.

request.name: set_pending_position

description.summary: change the shell surface position

request.description: Move the surface to new coordinates. Coordinates are global. The position will be applied on the next wl_surface.commit.

interface.name: ukui_decoration_v1

description.summary: metadata interface

interface.description:
It provides requests to set surface need to draw corner/shadow/border or not.
On the server side the object is automatically destroyed when the related wl_surface is destroyed. On client side, ukui_decoration_v1.destroy() must be called before destroying the wl_surface object.

request.name: set_no_titlebar

description.summary: make the surface not to show titlebar

request.description:
Setting this will say the surface prefers not to show titlebar.
This request needs be called before surface map.

arg.name: no_titlebar
arg.summary: Boolean value that to disable titlebar

request.name: set_decoration_components

description.summary: set components of decoration for the surface

request.description: The flags bitfield describes which components of decoration are supposed to be set and can be set together in a bitfield. Draw decoration will be based on the flags. This flags needs be called before surface map and become immutable when surface is mapped. This request is only for xdg_popup now.

description.summary: remove ukui_decoration_v1 interface
